job.label: Service pistol repaint — Celestial
job.keep_line: the same single right-facing level side-view service pistol repaint, broad straight dark steel slide with its current angular front bevel, dark circular muzzle, three rear sloping serration cuts, rectangular upper-side port and small original top sights, stepped lower frame/dust cover, short rectangular trigger guard with its single curved trigger, and downward-sloping blue-grey inset grip panel secured by TWO round metal pins over the same dark grip base. Preserve every slide corner, port, sight, screw, trigger gap, under-frame step and grip angle; the magazine remains flush at the bottom. The original muted steel-blue grip inset stays at its current place. No accessory rail addition, optic, enlarged magazine, logo, lettering or external effect.
job.prompt:
Paint ONE Celestial Service Pistol inventory icon for the fictional RPG Project Heaven Cry. Only a2D digital painting. First attachment is a technical reference pair: LEFT Standard fixes exact visible geometry/pose/framing; RIGHT Relic supplies every prior surface addition and its position. Render one complete pistol only, no panel, label, second object or scene. Second attachment supplies Heavenprint brushwork only, no person.

Celestial appearance: same silhouette and exact part/opening positions, THREE rear cuts and TWO grip pins. Pearl-ivory unmarked metal and ivory grip with a faint muted steel-blue trace only where the original grip inset was. Existing brass becomes pale warm gold-ivory. Keep the Relic flush scroll panel in its EXACT location and shape, now clean pale material with fine scroll seams; keep the SINGLE repaired lower grip pin in the same hole and size, pale cool silver contrasting subtly with the warmer upper pin. No repair/ornament is removed, moved, enlarged or added. The existing upper-side inlay route and ONE original frame seam have faint contained ivory-gold inner light, no wider than those thin surfaces. Muzzle and other openings remain dark. No light beyond the object, no halo or bloom.

Opaque Heavenprint gouache/ink, directional broken brushstrokes, selective dry-brush, charcoal shadows, warm ivory focal edges and upper-left light. Single transparent SQUARE1024x1024RGBA canvas, same reference framing and at least50px clear margin. No ground, cast shadow, hand, figure, text, letters, numbers, logo, real brand, border, frame, smoke, flash or outside effects. Exterior artwork only; no diagram or instructions.

prompt_revisions.previous_prompt:
Repaint the attached game inventory icon as a higher grade of the very same object. This is the same item, not a new one: keep exactly its silhouette and outline, every part and where it sits, its proportions and lengths, the camera angle, the pose and the diagonal, the scale in the frame and the margins, the light from the upper left and the short painted shading on its own underside. Keep the maker's signature parts named below exactly as they are. Change only the surface: finish, material, wear, inlay and ornament, as the grade below says, and keep every addition inside the existing outline (flush, inlaid, engraved, stitched or wrapped on). Same style as the attached painting: Heavenprint, hand-painted opaque gouache and ink with broken directional brush strokes, dry-brush scumbling, charcoal shadows, warm ivory highlights on the focal edges. Not line art, not flat ink, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no airbrushed gloss. Fully transparent background, square 1024 x 1024 PNG with alpha, no ground, no cast shadow, no scene. No text, letters, numbers, logos or real heraldry; the maker's own blank crest, seal plate or tag stays exactly as it is, and no new symbol is added. No hands, no figures. No frame, no border, no coloured rim: the game draws the grade frame. Do not add parts that change the outline: no new spikes, guards, blades, rails, scopes, gems standing proud, ribbons, tassels, chains, wings, auras, smoke or sparks. It must read at 64 px in a shop grid and at 32 px in a backpack row as the same item as the attached one, one grade higher.

Preserve every slide corner, port, sight, screw, trigger gap, under-frame step and grip angle; the magazine remains flush at the bottom. The original muted steel-blue grip inset stays at its current place. No accessory rail addition, optic, enlarged magazine, logo, lettering or external effect.
